\begin{bankq}[id=TOAS17-P1-MATH-S1-Q05, source={TOAS - Test 17 (18 Sep 2022)}, paper=1, qno=5, type=multi, subtopic={Angles}, answer={A,B,C}, answer_src=key, difficulty=5, diff_parts={K1 S2 I1 C1 F1}, diff_note={concepts: geometry of a square pyramid | steps: volume; dihedral angle with the base; dihedral angle between faces; largest tetrahedron}]
Consider a pyramid built on a square base of side 2 such that the lengths of the line segments joining its apex to the 4 corners of the base are equal and the height of the structure is equal to the length of a side of its base. Then which of the following statements is/are true
\begin{qoptions}
\opt{A}{volume of the pyramid is $\dfrac83$}
\opt{B}{the angle between the base and any other face is $\sin^{-1}\dfrac2{\sqrt5}$}
\opt{C}{the angle between two faces with common edge which passes through the apex is $\cos^{-1}\dfrac15$}
\opt{D}{volume of the largest tetrahedron that can be inscribed in the pyramid is 1}
\end{qoptions}
\end{bankq}

\begin{qoptions}

\opt{C}{The three planes intersect in a line}
